values./system/description:
A makeshift weapon using air pressure to propel customized syringes at a target. This inflicts little damage by itself, but the syringes can inflict a wide range of debilitating effects.

A Syringer can accept one each of the following mods:

  • Barrel: Long Barrel
  • Stock: Marksman’s, Recoil-Compensating
  • Sights: Reflex Sight, Short Scope, Long Scope, Short Night Vision Scope, Long Night Vision Scope, Recon Scope
